prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

{
  "cases": [
    {
      "i": 10140,
      "title": "Fee Analyzer subscription failed to renew in LATAM Production",
      "description": "Hello Support,

We are experiencing an issue with our Fee Analyzer subscription in the LATAM production environment. The subscription did not renew automatically as expected, which has effectively suspended access for approximately 45 users.

We noticed this when users started receiving access errors today. Could you please check the billing/subscription status and help us restore access as soon as possible? We need this resolved to avoid impacting our ongoing fee analysis workflows.

Thanks,
Customer Ops Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10141,
      "title": "Analytics Dashboard config drift and missing env vars in ANZ Development",
      "description": "Hi there,

We're seeing configuration issues with the Analytics Dashboard in our ANZ development environment. Specifically, we have detected config drift and noticed that certain environment variables are missing, which means new configuration changes are not taking effect.

About 17 developers are currently blocked because they cannot apply the latest dashboard settings. We've verified the variables exist in our source control but they aren't reflecting in the deployed environment. Please investigate the sync between our config repo and the dev instance.

Best,
Dev Lead"
    },
    {
      "i": 10142,
      "title": "URGENT: Data residency flag mismatch on Analytics Dashboard in US-West Prod",
      "description": "To Support,

We have identified a critical data residency compliance issue. The Analytics Dashboard in the US-West production environment is showing a data residency flag mismatch. This affects approximately 494 active users and poses a significant compliance risk.

We need immediate confirmation that data is being processed in the correct geographic region and a fix for the flag discrepancy. Please treat this as high priority due to regulatory implications.

Regards,
Compliance Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10143,
      "title": "Mobile app performance degradation linked to Analytics Dashboard in ANZ Staging",
      "description": "Hello,

We are observing slow performance on the mobile app when interacting with the Analytics Dashboard in the ANZ staging environment. About 47 users are experiencing lag and timeouts.

The issue appears isolated to the mobile interface; the web dashboard seems fine. Could you check if there are backend latency issues or resource constraints affecting the staging mobile API endpoints?

Thanks,
QA Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10144,
      "title": "High replication lag in Cohort Builder Staging (US-East) - Hardware Failure?",
      "description": "Hi Support,

We are seeing consistently high replication lag in the Cohort Builder staging environment (US-East). This is impacting 348 users who rely on up-to-date cohort data.

We strongly suspect this is due to an infrastructure hardware failure on your end. The latency is too high to be a software configuration issue. Please inspect the physical servers or network hardware immediately.

Thanks,
Data Engineering"
    },
    {
      "i": 10145,
      "title": "MFA codes rejected and account lockouts in Payment Gateway v2 (ME Prod)",
      "description": "Hello,

Two of our users are unable to access the Payment Gateway v2 production environment in the ME region. They report that their MFA codes are being rejected, which has subsequently led to their accounts being locked out.

This is a low-impact issue for the broader organization but critical for these two individuals. Please assist in unlocking their accounts and investigating why valid MFA codes are failing.

Best,
IT Support"
    },
    {
      "i": 10146,
      "title": "Incorrect invoices and chargeback notices on Payment Gateway v2 (EU-Central Dev)",
      "description": "Hi,

We are encountering incorrect invoice generation and receiving unexpected chargeback notices in the Payment Gateway v2 development environment (EU-Central). This affects a small group of 5 testers.

We are fairly confident this is a known product limitation regarding test mode billing cycles. If that's the case, please confirm so we can adjust our testing procedures accordingly. Otherwise, please investigate why test invoices are incorrect.

Thanks,
Finance Dev Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10147,
      "title": "CRITICAL: Duplicate records appearing in Cohort Builder (US-West Prod)",
      "description": "Urgent Support Request,

We have detected a massive number of duplicate records in the Cohort Builder production environment (US-West). This is impacting approximately 3,460 users and is severely degrading the accuracy of our marketing cohorts.

This is a critical data integrity issue. Please escalate immediately. We need a fix for the duplication logic and guidance on how to clean the existing data.

Thanks,
Marketing Ops"
    },
    {
      "i": 10148,
      "title": "Onboarding Wizard unresponsive in US-West Sandbox",
      "description": "Hello,

The Onboarding Wizard service in the US-West sandbox environment is unresponsive. Users cannot proceed through the onboarding flow. About 22 users are affected.

This is blocking our training and testing activities. Please check the service health in the sandbox and restore availability.

Best,
Enablement Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10149,
      "title": "Truncated file exports from Analytics Dashboard (US-West Dev)",
      "description": "Hi Support,

We are noticing truncated file exports when downloading data from the Analytics Dashboard in the US-West development environment. The files appear cut off prematurely.

This affects about 35 developers who rely on these exports for local testing. Please investigate the export size limits or generation process in the dev instance.

Thanks,
Backend Dev"
    },
    {
      "i": 10150,
      "title": "Queue Manager application crash in US-West Production",
      "description": "Urgent,

The Queue Manager application is crashing repeatedly in the US-West production environment. This is impacting 152 users and causing message processing delays.

Please investigate the cause of the crashes and stabilize the service. We are seeing intermittent downtime and loss of queue visibility.

Thanks,
Platform Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10151,
      "title": "Critical Audit Log Gaps and Retention Policy Failure in Analytics Dashboard (ANZ Sandbox)",
      "description": "Hello,

We have identified a critical compliance issue in the Analytics Dashboard sandbox environment (ANZ). Audit log entries are missing, and we have detected gaps in the logging stream. Furthermore, the configured retention policies do not appear to be applied correctly.

This affects visibility for 16,325 users and poses a severe audit risk. Please investigate the logging pipeline and retention configuration immediately.

Regards,
Security Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10152,
      "title": "CRITICAL: Partial Outage and Failover Failure in Deploy Manager (APAC Prod)",
      "description": "URGENT ESCALATION,

We are experiencing a partial outage in the Deploy Manager production environment (APAC). The automated failover mechanism did not trigger as expected, leaving systems down.

This is a critical incident affecting 13,407 users. We need immediate manual intervention to restore services and an explanation for why the failover failed.

Thanks,
Incident Response"
    },
    {
      "i": 10153,
      "title": "Replication Lag and Backup Verification Failures in Active Directory Sync (EU-West Prod)",
      "description": "Hi,

We are observing high replication lag in the Active Directory Sync service in the EU-West production environment. Additionally, recent backup verification attempts have failed.

This currently affects 5 users, so it is low impact, but we are concerned about the data integrity risks. Please investigate the sync latency and backup job errors.

Best,
Identity Team"
    },
    {
      "i": 10154,
      "title": "Missing audit logs in Analytics Dashboard",
      "description": "Hey, the audit logs for the Analytics Dashboard are missing entries. We're in LATAM production. Users are complaining they can't find history. Please fix. It's affecting around 60 people I think. Don't have exact details right now."
    }
